objective: Prove macro evidence, deterministic overlays and accurate education from real footage plus graphics; no generated vehicle parts.
mechanicTruth: Uneven wear can point to alignment, inflation, worn suspension parts or skipped rotations; an inspection tells which. A tire worn on one edge is evidence that something changed how it meets the road, not a diagnosis by itself.
loopIdea: The closing beat settles back on the same macro of the worn edge under the same inspection light, so the loop restarts on the evidence the hook opened with.
selectedCaption: One edge of this tire wore smooth. That is the tire telling on something: alignment, pressure, a worn part or skipped rotations. A 10-minute inspection says which. Comment TREAD or book an inspection — Nick's Tire & Auto, Euclid Ave, Cleveland.
voiceoverScript: One edge of this tire wore smooth. A tread gauge shows the difference. Uneven wear can point to alignment, pressure, a worn part, or skipped rotations. The tire shows the pattern; the inspection says which. One edge worn? Get it checked.
